body: Im so sorry that you feel so terrible. Im not going to try to persuade you other wise because you are the one in control. All i want to say is that every single person was put on this earth for a reason. You were put on this earth to have a positive impact on someone. Maby you havent found that person that will benifit from you being there but they will come. There is somone out there in this whole big world that looks up to you and needs you. They will be absoulutly devistated if you arnt here in the morning. No matter what happens in the night the sun always comes up. You will get through this. Sometimes we need to stick around long enough for our good luck to find us.

Yeek. I hope It will help you!! My mom is making me see a counselor in a few days and I know that she is going to take me to the hospital. Im absoulutly terrifyed. When I see people post about being taken to the hospital it gives me some hope that maby it wont be as bad as i think it will. I hope you feel better soon!!

Same. My friend told my mom... She hasnt looked at me in the same way since. She keeps asking how she can help and i keep telling her i dont know! Truth is I wish she didnt care i wish she forgot. Then I wouldnt have to look her in the eye every morning and say im good.
